name: gp-prefer
prompt: In server/src/gameplan.rs replace the body of `pub fn prefer_library` (currently `todo!()`). For every asset task of `plan.asset_tasks` that has a `workflow` and no `library_id`: look for library assets with the same `kind` (compare lower-cased) that share at least one tag with the task's `tags` (tags compare lower-cased); count the shared tags per library asset; take the one with the most shared tags, and on a tie the one with the smallest `id` (string order). When one is found set the task's `library_id` to Some(its id), `workflow` to None and clear `params`, and push the task's key onto the result. Return the keys in plan order. Tasks that already use the library or have no match are left alone. Change nothing else.
